lines.t: There is a sound upon the mountain, There is a cry across the land, A trumpet calling to the sleeping, “Wake, arise, and take your stand!” Lift your eyes above the darkness, Let your hearts be still and hear; For the Bridegroom comes in glory, And the day of His appearing draws near.
So do not sleep, beloved, Do not let your lamps grow dim; The One for whom our hearts have waited Is coming— We will go out to meet Him!
WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, THE KING OF GLORY SHALL APPEAR! EVERY KNEE WILL BOW, EVERY TONGUE CRY OUT, THE LORD YAHUSHUA IS HERE!
LIFT YOUR VOICE, REJOICE, REJOICE! OUR REDEMPTION DRAWETH NIGH! THE BRIDEGROOM COMES, THE HOLY ONE— AND WE SHALL SEE HIM IN THE SKY!
WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, OUR LONGING WILL BE OVER! WE'LL BE WITH HIM EVERMORE— OUR KING, OUR LOVE, OUR SAVIOR AND OUR LORD!

The voice has gone into the nations, The warning has gone forth; “Make way for the coming of the Lord!” Prepare the way before the King, Let every heart awake— The trumpet sounds throughout the earth,
So lift your eyes, beloved, The promise is not far; The One who said, “I am coming,” Is faithful to His word.
WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, THE KING OF GLORY SHALL APPEAR! EVERY KNEE WILL BOW, EVERY TONGUE CRY OUT, THE LORD YAHUSHUA IS HERE!
LIFT YOUR VOICE, REJOICE, REJOICE! OUR REDEMPTION DRAWETH NIGH! THE BRIDEGROOM COMES, THE HOLY ONE— AND WE SHALL SEE HIM IN THE SKY!
WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, WHEN THE TRUMPET SOUNDS, OUR LONGING WILL BE OVER! WE'LL BE WITH HIM EVERMORE— OUR KING, OUR LOVE, OUR SAVIOR AND OUR LORD!
